bootstrap.intervals: Pointwise percentile95%; not simultaneous or multiple-comparison corrected
bootstrap.uncertainty: Episode variation under the fixed 16-per-time design, conditional on one frozen checkpoint; zero simulator Monte Carlo error

limitations: Development diagnostic; no efficacy or confirmation claim.
ActualU=0 yields degenerate BCA scores, not positive usefulness evidence.
RMS matching fixes fitting-bank magnitude, not information content or gradient strength.
Regret is restricted to the supplied candidate banks, not globally optimal control.
Frozen discrete reranking does not establish trained actor improvement.
Current-policy values may differ from the critic's smoothed lagged target-policy estimand.
Fitting/evaluation provenance, deterministic simulator and checkpoint authenticity are caller gates.

ledger.source_authentication: Caller authenticates full core; canonical_config authenticates canonical files
ledger.value_scope: Deterministic finite-horizon value of each first action followed by the same frozen actor
ledger.numeric_scope: Float64 state/reward accumulation with float32 actor observations/actions; no rigorous floating-point error bound

verification.terminal_value_algebra: At t=99: Q=r99 + gamma*0 = r99; no t=100 reward or bootstrap
verification.comparison: Exact float64 states/rewards; exact float32 observations and finite-task flags

ledger.conditional_value_error_note: No Monte Carlo sampling error conditional on these saved states and deterministic actor. Finite-precision error remains; population uncertainty and candidate selection uncertainty are separate.

claim_scope: Frozen first-action selection only; no policy-training efficacy, chosen kappa or Q1-error coverage guarantee
